title: Derived bifunctor restriction to resolving cochain pairs
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category with its unbounded derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $B$ be any category, and let $P$ be a predicate on cochain complexes in $A$. Assume every cochain complex $K$ receives a quasi-isomorphism $L\to K$ with $P(L)$. If $i:P\hookrightarrow C(A)$ is the full subcategory inclusion and $Q:C(A)\to D(A)$ is localization, then precomposition by $(iQ)\times(iQ)$ is fully faithful from functors $D(A)\times D(A)\to B$ to functors $P\times P\to B$. No closure hypothesis on $P$ is required.

source.place: Localization universal property, Tags 04VI--04VK; cochain specialization of lem-weil-pbc-resolving-representative-whiskering.

proof.text: On the homotopy category put H(K)=P(K.as). Choose a resolving quasi-isomorphism to each underlying cochain complex. Its image under the homotopy quotient is a quasi-isomorphism with source in H; the quotient-map quasi-isomorphism characterization gives precisely this assertion.

Apply the general resolving-representative fully faithful whiskering theorem to the full, surjective homotopy quotient and the derived localization with its right calculus of fractions. The compatibility of the two predicates is definitional.

In both variables transport the resulting fully faithful functor along quotientCompQhIso. Whiskering this product natural isomorphism identifies the resulting precomposition with the stated precomposition by the direct cochain localization.

theorem derivedResolvingPairRestriction
    {A : Type*} [Category A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory A]
    (B : Type*) [Category B] (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex A ℤ))
    (res : ∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      ∃ (L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (a : L ⟶ K), P L ∧ QuasiIso a) :
    Nonempty (((Functor.whiskeringLeft (P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory)
      (DerivedCategory A × DerivedCategory A) B).obj
        ((P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod (P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))).FullyFaithful)
